label: TP
reason: User-controlled HTTP header names flow through doSomething() into bar variable and are concatenated directly into HTML response output without proper encoding/sanitization. The replace() call only changes the last character to Z, leaving rest of user input unencoded and potentially executable JavaScript.

evidence.note: Header names extracted from request and passed to doSomething
Parameter flows to bar with minimal sanitization (only last char changed)
Unsanitized bar value concatenated into HTML response
